description: Rebuild collision geometry across the full workspace from the current registered observation on every call. Use measured table cuboids, currently registered CAD, and current TSDF/ESDF for all remaining visible geometry. Anonymous obstacles require no identity association. Apply the strict workspace mask. Replace previous object geometry and TSDF cells; retain permanent identity and operation history separately in the database. There is no local/global selector or object subset. Unknown target surfaces retain current capture provenance for GraspGen. A full rebuild does not certify unseen space as empty.
capability: Publish database-version-bound collision geometry: measured table cuboids, registered CAD and unknown object ESDF from current masked-depth TSDF
